problem:
Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

A line segment $\overset{―}{AB}$ has endpoints at $A(1,-2)$ and $B(-2,1).$ What are the coordinates of the corresponding endpoints of $\overset{―}{{A}^{′}{B}^{′}}$, the image of $\overset{―}{AB}$ under the action of $T?$

Consider the linear transformation $\mathbf T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14056071/assets/73f0065d4d4768a2c3432559702c2db28fefd050194a5bcdfe44ac3e0b736c82.png)

The line segment $\overline{AB}$ is shown below. Find $\overline{A'B'},$ the image of $\overline{AB}$ under the action of $\mathbf T.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14056071/assets/2e22400d15abc81150d6d18de591549e81a46bd16ab9e95f10f86bae2125b490.png)
examples.worked_solution:
To find the image of $\overline{AB}$ under the action of $\mathbf T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing the coordinates of the endpoints of $\overline{AB}\mathbin{:}$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14056071/assets/fe82a0c8616e43c9d8db0b2892a145fcabf4cfa17bd3d4e033a1349cd25921ee.png)

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $\mathbf T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the respective endpoints of the image are $A'(1,3)$ and $B'(1,-2),$ as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14056071/assets/472f8e712f7d695d5ab3593dafbcc0309feb1a6ac80e9e29c4893dc651d20cf7.png)
